//: Deploy with: firebase deploy --only storage,database. This file is the source of truth for Realtime Database rules. Anonymous sign-in exists only so the AI proxy has a token to verify (see worker/README.md); there is no account behind an anonymous session, so every rule requires a real sign-in provider rather than a bare 'auth != null', which would grant any device that opens the app.

locations.//: subscribeToNearbyUsers() reads this whole node, so the read grant must live here rather than on $uid.

$eventId..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider != 'anonymous' && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('reportedBy').val() == auth.uid) || (data.exists() && (data.child('reportedBy').val() == auth.uid || !newData.exists())))

friend-requests.//: The client reads and filters this whole node, so authenticated reads are intentionally broad.

$requestId..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider != 'anonymous' && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('fromUserId').val() == auth.uid) || (data.exists() && (data.child('fromUserId').val() == auth.uid || data.child('toUserId').val() == auth.uid)))

messages.//: Conversation IDs are the two participant UIDs sorted and joined with '_' (MessagingService.getConversationId), so participation is derivable from the key. Firebase UIDs contain no underscores, making these prefix/suffix checks exact.

$messageId..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider != 'anonymous' && ($conversationId.beginsWith(auth.uid + '_') || $conversationId.endsWith('_' + auth.uid)) && (newData.child('senderId').val() == auth.uid || data.child('senderId').val() == auth.uid)

$adventureId..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider != 'anonymous' && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('userId').val() == auth.uid) || (data.exists() && (data.child('userId').val() == auth.uid || !newData.exists())))

$submissionId..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider != 'anonymous' && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('userId').val() == auth.uid) || (data.exists() && data.child('userId').val() == auth.uid))

scan-submission-images.//: Images are separate so the metadata subscription does not download every image. The submission must be written first because this rule checks its owner.
